purpose: Provide one renderer-neutral truth, identity, authority, lifecycle, and composition dataset for the first Life visual-composition round and later native lab.
prohibited_uses: Do not treat this file as autobiographical truth beyond the explicitly controlled founder-story fixture.
Do not infer personality, emotional state, relationship quality, cultural sophistication, or identity.
Do not treat a ticket, reservation, photograph, save, or Plan as occurrence evidence by itself.
Do not widen audience or precision from historic membership, co-occurrence, or visual prominence.
Do not translate the semantic sections into a server-authored component tree.
Do not promote a nested or contextual object into a stable Life door because its visual treatment is engaging.

identity_contract.restoration_rule: Restore the surviving semantic resource, section, and item anchor under current authority before applying an optional local reading offset.
identity_contract.revocation_rule: A projection whose audience epoch is no longer valid is synchronously removed; a less-scoped payload is never used as fallback.

source_catalog.proves: A flight record exists for the represented route and date.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: Boarding, arrival, or the complete Journey.

source_catalog.proves: A rail booking exists; separate occurrence evidence supports the represented segment.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: Every planned stop or later transfer.

source_catalog.proves: A ferry was booked or considered.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: That the ferry was taken.

source_catalog.proves: Stay records exist; represented stays have separate occurrence support.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: Satisfaction, meaning, or every night of presence.

source_catalog.proves: The fixture owner captured the represented media at supported times or Places.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: Consent of depicted people, emotional meaning, or all surrounding events.

source_catalog.proves: The fixture owner explicitly noticed heat, walking, cliffs, pasta, crowds, transit, or cultural encounters where represented.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: A durable trait or general preference.

source_catalog.proves: A museum ticket or reservation existed.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: Attendance or a museum visit.

source_catalog.proves: The fixture owner explicitly said the museum visit did not occur.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: Why it did not occur or any regret.

source_catalog.proves: The fixture owner supplied evidence of the represented film encounter before Rome.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: A mythology identity, expertise, or the later historical relation.

source_catalog.proves: At the Colosseum, the fixture owner explicitly connected the Trojan War, Aeneas, Rome, and the earlier film.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: The broader mechanism or historical interpretation supplied by Vesper.

source_catalog.proves: Only claims individually linked to reviewed sources in the eventual composition.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: Any personal meaning, occurrence, or unsupported generalization.

source_catalog.proves: The invitation and its governed revisions exist.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: Attendance, contribution fulfillment, or shared sentiment.

source_catalog.proves: Maya committed to bring dessert.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: That dessert was brought unless occurrence evidence supports it.

source_catalog.proves: Maya contributed the represented photograph under the stated audience epoch.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: Group sentiment or permission outside the Occasion.

source_catalog.proves: Alex contributed the represented receipt.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: Who owes what without a governed expense decision.

source_catalog.proves: Only the city-level, time-bounded, attributed Paris details explicitly included in the grant.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: Maya's full trip, live location, relationship state, or public availability.

source_catalog.proves: The represented Red Hook Places or routes were saved.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: A visit, recurrence, importance, or affinity.

source_catalog.proves: The represented visits have independent occurrence support.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: Identity, preference strength, or future intent.

source_catalog.proves: A bounded shared dinner episode occurred under the represented authority.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: Private participant Outcomes or continuing relationship state.

source_catalog.proves: The fixture owner explicitly authored the represented evaluation, such as would repeat or not for me.
source_catalog.does_not_prove: A neighborhood-wide preference or identity.

worlds.title: Nice to Rome, then home
worlds.truth_summary: Supported stays, movements, encounters, and return coexist with planned-only, corrected, and unresolved segments.
must_show: Supported city and movement chapters lead.
The unused ferry and museum remain planned-only or explicitly not-lived.
Sources nest under the claims, movements, and encounters they support.
The Journey can hand supported context into present New York without inferring a travel identity.
must_not: Artifact counts as the primary value.
A continuous route fabricated across evidence gaps.
A prose recap of everything captured.
A travel-style or personality interpretation.

worlds.title: Dinner in Brooklyn
worlds.truth_summary: One Occasion changes emphasis across prospective, live, recent, and historical states while shared core, personal overlay, contributions, and Outcomes remain distinct.
must_show: One stable Occasion identity across lifecycle.
Attributed human contributions and plural Outcomes.
Shared core plus viewer-private overlay.
Afterglow is optional and complete without participant homework.
must_not: A required Occasion profile.
A participation score or contribution ranking.
Everyone loved it unless explicitly authored and authorized.
A communal camera-roll dump.

worlds.title: Museum ticket not used
worlds.truth_summary: Ticket possessed and visit intended; explicit correction says attendance did not occur.
must_show: The ticket remains retrievable.
The Plan remains part of decision history.
The museum is absent from occurred and visited projections.
must_not: An independent museum memory door.
Regret, failure, or completion pressure.
A visited pin or completed experience.

worlds.title: Film, Troy, and Rome
worlds.truth_summary: The owner made the initial film-to-Colosseum connection; Vesper may add a sourced explanation only if it advances beyond that observation.
must_show: Human observation and Vesper contribution remain distinct.
Material generated claims have inspectable citations.
A saved composition remains derived from its Sources.
must_not: Restating that the film and Colosseum both involve the Trojan story.
Trivia or congratulating the person for noticing.
A mythology-person identity label.

worlds.title: Rome and Paris in the same heat
worlds.truth_summary: Two separately owned, attributed lanes may be compared only on one authorized, substantive axis.
must_show: Two attributed lanes.
One coherent comparison axis.
Current audience and Place precision.
Graceful degradation to one-person value or silence after revocation.
must_not: A generic friend activity tile.
A synthetic joint trip or pooled media ownership.
Retrospective live-location surveillance.
Competitive city ranking.

worlds.title: Red Hook across time
worlds.truth_summary: Several supported visits, routes, Occasions, and explicit evaluations can earn a longitudinal Place doorway; saves and plans remain distinct.
must_show: Constituent episodes and explicit states.
The difference between one save and supported recurrence.
Life history handing off to refreshed current Places truth.
A complete ordered alternative to any map-led treatment.
must_not: You love Red Hook.
A waterfront-transition personality claim.
A visit-frequency leaderboard, badge, or heatmap-as-importance.
Duplicated current provider truth inside Life.

social_transitions.name: active_valid_grants
social_transitions.expected: Shared core and attributed granted lanes render; private Outcomes do not.

social_transitions.name: invitation_declined
social_transitions.expected: Invitation truth remains; no participant or attendee return is created.

social_transitions.name: invitation_deferred
social_transitions.expected: Uncertainty remains explicit; no attendance or relationship interpretation is inferred.

social_transitions.name: participant_leaves
social_transitions.expected: Ordinary occurred Occasion preserves a frozen historical shared core; no new shared return or updates.

social_transitions.name: contribution_withdrawn
social_transitions.expected: The contribution and solely dependent claims disappear without leakage paraphrase.

social_transitions.name: source_deleted
social_transitions.expected: Unsupported claims, caches, snippets, and pending handoffs invalidate causally.

social_transitions.name: audience_or_precision_narrowed
social_transitions.expected: All reads and generated text recompile at current permission and precision.

social_transitions.name: block
social_transitions.expected: Unsafe relationship and social-periphery rendering is synchronously suppressed; independent history remains.

social_transitions.name: estrangement_without_block
social_transitions.expected: No inferred safety or relationship state; only explicit shields change resurfacing.

social_transitions.name: unblock
social_transitions.expected: Only the block overlay ends; grants, membership, rank, and Continue do not restore.

social_transitions.name: reconciliation
social_transitions.expected: New grants use a new epoch; old compositions do not silently reactivate.

social_transitions.name: account_deletion
social_transitions.expected: Deleted-user product access and grants end; other independently owned state remains.

social_transitions.name: verified_death
social_transitions.expected: No audience expansion, synthetic speech, inferred wishes, or proactive revival without explicit directive.

social_transitions.name: managed_export_or_screenshot
social_transitions.expected: Managed exports preserve dependency identity; the product does not promise revocation of external screenshots.

global_invariants: All six worlds coexist in the complete product world.
Only L01 rich, L02, and L06 supported recurrence are stable full episode doors in round one.
L03 remains not-lived, L04 remains derived, and L05 remains addressed and revocable.
Combined, Mine, and Together recompile one identity graph; they do not copy owners.
Every material generated claim retains claim-local source roles.
Every rich visual treatment has a complete ordered accessible alternative.
Continue carries context and previews consequence; it does not create state without authorization.
Quiet and sparse states deliver retrieval and truth without asking for maintenance.
The index and episode renderers preserve semantic identity across Timeline, Map, Sources, Home, Chat, and Places.
A fallback may reduce richness but never authority.
